notes.title: The Crimson Dungeon Update - Part 2 (More Enemies)
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650634/c72bebb1deefe96af79c6d912c433ee443b2f7bd.png"]

The Crimson Dungeon Update Part 2 adds more enemies to the map location.

QOL updates have been made to the Fire Missile and Movement Speed upgrades.

Enemies in The Crimson Dungeon include but not limited to: spiders, skeletons, boulder golems, dungeon crawlers, wraiths, and zombies.

Thanks for keeping up with the updates, and thanks to the players!

GnarlyTree

notes.title: The Crimson Dungeon Update (New Map + Enemies)
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650634/c72bebb1deefe96af79c6d912c433ee443b2f7bd.png"]

The Crimson Dungeon is the 2nd map location within Vanquish Evil. It features it's own unique dungeon atmosphere, immersed in a crimson stained lighting which is then faded into pure black darkness.



There are several dungeon coffins to open for items.

There features new enemies, one of which is called the Dungeon Crawler -- an undead cadaver that crawls along the dungeon floor.

Several new enemy types and bosses will be added to The Crimson Dungeon!

More updates on the way very soon! Thanks for playing!

GnarlyTree Games

notes.notes:

Now available in-game! Go play Vanquish Evil to find the Magic Leaf!

The Vanquish Evil demo has been updated with major improvements:
